purpose: Requirements for the agenda record layer that stores agenda items (review findings, discussion points) and their states as a single source of truth, so humans keep an overview while the AI spends less effort maintaining records.
summary: Overview: a conversation tool keeping all agenda items and their states visible, justified only if it reduces AI output and reading effort for record upkeep
Terminology: agenda item, agenda, record, presentation, caller; the word triage is not used
Scope: record storage, state transitions, input and output with callers, location, count, lifetime, and discarding old records; presentation is out of scope
FNC-004 to FNC-006: AI generates only judgment content, input is one structured handoff with one value, and next actions are obtained without counting
FNC-008: transition preconditions are a machine-readable definition and invalid transitions are rejected with a discernible reason
FNC-009: callers supply record count, identification, lifetime, severity key name, and state vocabulary instead of fixed values
FNC-010 and FNC-013: discard of existing review and consult records, and retention of change information for the display layer
FNC-012: before any item transition, a structural validity judgment over the whole set must be recorded, including a no-error judgment with rationale
NFR-001 to NFR-006: storage format with its own value boundaries, derived location and lifetime, unit tests, no secret values, and visible failures
Open items TBD-003, TBD-004, TBD-006 with resolutions referencing the design document
tasks: Designing or implementing the agenda mechanism data storage layer
Implementing state transition checks and rejection reasons for agenda items
Integrating a caller such as consult or review with the agenda record
Choosing a storage format for work records
Reviewing agenda requirements and designs for consistency
Writing unit tests for the agenda record mechanism
Handling secrets in recorded review findings
title: REQ-019 議事記録機構 要件定義書
